notes: Hand-seeded from the vLLM documentation, not extracted from this exact build. Flags whose default depends on the model (enable-prefix-caching, enable-chunked-prefill, block-size, max-num-batched-tokens) carry default null on purpose: a null default is never dropped, so an explicitly passed value always survives into the fingerprint. That is the conservative direction — it can split two configurations that were in fact identical, but it can never merge two that were not.

params.name: model
params.help: Hugging Face id or local path of the weights. Dropped from the fingerprint: the model is already part of the cell.

params.name: tensor-parallel-size
params.help: Number of GPUs to shard each layer across.

params.name: pipeline-parallel-size
params.help: Number of pipeline stages.

params.name: data-parallel-size
params.help: Number of independent replicas behind one endpoint.

params.name: distributed-executor-backend
params.help: How workers are launched. Defaults to mp for single node, ray for multi node.

params.name: gpu-memory-utilization
params.help: Fraction of device memory the engine may claim, weights included. Everything left over after weights becomes KV cache.

params.name: swap-space
params.help: CPU swap space per GPU in GiB for preempted sequences.

params.name: cpu-offload-gb
params.help: GiB of weights to keep in CPU memory. Slow; use only when the model does not fit.

params.name: max-model-len
params.help: Context length the engine advertises. Defaults to the model's own maximum, which is often far more KV cache than you have.

params.name: max-num-seqs
params.help: Maximum sequences in a batch.

params.name: max-num-batched-tokens
params.help: Token budget per scheduler step. Defaults depend on whether chunked prefill is on.

params.name: enable-chunked-prefill
params.help: Split long prefills across scheduler steps so decodes are not starved. Enabled by default in V1 for most models.

params.name: enable-prefix-caching
params.help: Reuse KV blocks for shared prefixes. On by default in V1 for most models but OFF for hybrid-attention models, so pass it explicitly and record it.

params.name: block-size
params.help: KV cache block size in tokens.

params.name: kv-cache-dtype
params.help: KV cache element type. fp8 roughly doubles the cache at some accuracy cost.

params.name: mamba-ssm-cache-dtype
params.help: Element type of the Mamba/SSM state cache for hybrid models.

params.name: mamba-backend
params.help: Kernel backend for Mamba/SSM layers. Verify against the exact release: this flag is newer than most of the list.

params.name: disable-sliding-window
params.help: Ignore the model's sliding-window attention and use full attention.

params.name: quantization
params.help: Quantization method to apply or expect. Usually inferred from the checkpoint.

params.name: dtype
params.help: Activation and weight dtype.

params.name: speculative-config
params.help: Speculative decoding configuration, e.g. {"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}. The single biggest single-stream speedup on memory-bound machines.

params.name: compilation-config
params.help: torch.compile / CUDA graph configuration. -O3 style shorthand is accepted.

params.name: enforce-eager
params.help: Disable CUDA graphs. Slower, but it saves memory and makes tracebacks readable.

params.name: max-seq-len-to-capture
params.help: Longest sequence covered by a captured CUDA graph; longer requests fall back to eager.

params.name: cuda-graph-sizes
params.help: Batch sizes to capture CUDA graphs for.

params.name: scheduling-policy
params.help: Request scheduling policy.

params.name: num-scheduler-steps
params.help: Multi-step scheduling; removed in the V1 engine.

params.name: async-scheduling
params.help: Overlap scheduling with the forward pass.

params.name: preemption-mode
params.help: What to do when the KV cache is full.

params.name: reasoning-parser
params.help: Parser that splits reasoning content out of the response. Model specific: qwen3 resolves, qwen3_xml does not.

params.name: tool-call-parser
params.help: Parser for tool calls. Model specific: qwen3_xml resolves, qwen3 does not.

params.name: enable-auto-tool-choice
params.help: Let the model choose tools automatically; requires a tool-call parser.

params.name: trust-remote-code
params.help: Execute modelling code from the Hugging Face repo. Required by many new architectures.

params.name: tokenizer
params.help: Tokenizer id or path when it differs from the model.

params.name: tokenizer-mode
params.help: Tokenizer implementation.

params.name: hf-overrides
params.help: Overrides merged into the model's config.json, e.g. rope settings or a patched context length.

params.name: rope-scaling
params.help: RoPE scaling configuration, e.g. {"rope_type":"yarn","factor":4.0}.

params.name: rope-theta
params.help: RoPE base frequency override.

params.name: revision
params.help: Git revision of the weights repo. Dropped from the fingerprint but recorded in the result.

params.name: load-format
params.help: Weight loading format.

params.name: config-format
params.help: Model config format.

params.name: max-parallel-loading-workers
params.help: Parallelism while loading shards; lowers peak host memory.

params.name: seed
params.help: Random seed. Set it for anything you want reproducible.

params.name: max-logprobs
params.help: Maximum logprobs returned per token.

params.name: generation-config
params.help: Where default sampling parameters come from. Set to vllm to ignore the model's own generation_config.json.

params.name: override-generation-config
params.help: Overrides merged into the model's generation config.

params.name: limit-mm-per-prompt
params.help: Per-modality item limits, e.g. {"image":4}. Caps multimodal memory reservation.

params.name: mm-processor-kwargs
params.help: Extra arguments for the multimodal processor.

params.name: enable-lora
params.help: Enable LoRA adapters.

params.name: max-loras
params.help: Concurrent LoRA adapters per batch.

params.name: max-lora-rank
params.help: Maximum LoRA rank.

params.name: lora-modules
params.help: Adapters to preload, as name=path pairs.

params.name: enable-sleep-mode
params.help: Allow the engine to release device memory while idle.

params.name: kv-transfer-config
params.help: Disaggregated prefill / KV transfer configuration.

params.name: disable-custom-all-reduce
params.help: Fall back to NCCL for all-reduce.

params.name: disable-log-requests
params.help: Stop logging every request. Worth setting for high-concurrency runs.

params.name: disable-log-stats
params.help: Stop logging throughput statistics.

params.name: served-model-name
params.help: Name the API reports. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: host
params.help: Bind address. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: port
params.help: Bind port. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: api-key
params.help: Required API key. Dropped from the fingerprint and never recorded.

params.name: download-dir
params.help: Weight cache directory. Dropped from the fingerprint.
